subject: general
question: A man travelled a distance of 61 km in 9 h. He travelled partly on foot at the speed of 4 km/h and partly on bicycle at the speed of 9 km/h. What was the distance travelled on foot?
solution:
**GIVEN:**

Distance travelled in 9 h = 61 km 

Speed on foot = 4 km/h

Speed on bicycle = 9 km/h

**FORMULA USED:**

Distance = Speed × Time 

**CALCULATION:**

Let the distance traveled on foot be x, then

Distance traveled on a bicycle be (61 - x) 

Now, the Total time is taken to cover the whole distance = 9 hours

Distance/ Speed = Time 

⇒ x/4 + (61 - x)/9 = 9

⇒ (9x + 244 - 4x) /36 = 9

⇒ (5x + 244) = 36 × 9 = 324

⇒ 5x = 80

⇒ x = 16 

**Hence, the distance traveled on foot is 16 km.**
